gloss: to be divided, to branch off, to split into

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {分|わ}かれていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be divided, to split into, to branch off
definitions.explanation: For something to separate into two or more parts. Used for roads branching, groups splitting, opinions diverging, etc.

definitions.gloss: to be classified into, to fall into categories
definitions.explanation: To be divided into distinct categories or types.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pair: ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ (transitive, to divide/separate). Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧（Y⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧）{分|わ}かれる.

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{分|わ}かれ→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a resulting state: "is divided/split."

WRITING:
{分|わ}かれる and ⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧ are both read わかれる but differ in meaning. {分|わ}かれる means "to split/divide" (one thing becomes multiple), while ⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧ means "to part/say goodbye" (people separate from each other).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{分|わ}かれる (a road forks)
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{分|わ}かれる (opinions are divided)
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分|わ}かれる (to split into A and B)
